rows.q: Write out the main theme of Beethoven’s Ode to Joy with chords, so I can hear it.
rows.reply:
To write out the main theme of Beethoven's "Ode to Joy" with chords for you to hear, I will use the `MAKE MUSIC` function in Lantern. The key of the original piece is D major, but for simplicity and to match common arrangements, I'll use C major. Here is the chord progression and melody for the main theme:

```
MAKE MUSIC: Ode to Joy
key C major
style folk
chords C | G | Am | F | C | C | G | G
melody E E F G | G F E D | C C D E | E D D - |
END
```

This will create a simple arrangement of the "Ode to Joy" theme with the specified chords and melody. You can now listen to it in Lantern.
